en.headline: Vigil for Tung Chee-hwa begins this afternoon in North Point
en.dek: A wake runs from 3pm at Hong Kong Funeral Home, with a memorial service and cortege scheduled for Sunday morning.
body: A vigil for Hong Kong's first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, will be held from 3pm today at Fuk Hoi Hall in the Hong Kong Funeral Home in North Point.

A memorial service and encoffining ceremony are scheduled for 9am on Sunday, followed by a farewell and funeral procession towards Cape Collinson Crematorium in Chai Wan. The rites follow the standard used for other vice-state-level leaders, including draping the coffin with the national flag.

The Office of Former Chief Executives has said the Sunday memorial will be by invitation because of limited space at the venue. Three public condolence points in Causeway Bay, Kai Tak and Tsuen Wan remain open through Sunday for residents to sign books.

The Transport Department has already announced temporary traffic measures around North Point and Quarry Bay, including a ban on right turns from Java Road onto King's Road westbound between 9am and 11am on Sunday, and roadside parking suspensions from 2pm today until 10pm on Sunday. Drivers were advised to expect delays while the cortege moves.

zh.headline: 董建華設靈今日北角舉行
zh.dek: 香港殮儀館福海堂下午3時起設靈，週日上午舉行公祭及出殮。
body: 香港首任行政長官董建華的設靈儀式今日下午3時，在北角香港殮儀館福海堂舉行。
週日上午9時舉行公祭及入殮儀式，其後進行告別及出殮，靈車將前往柴灣歌連臣角火葬場。儀式按副國級領導人規格安排，包括以國旗覆蓋靈柴。
前任行政長官辦公室早前表示，因場地限制，週日的公祭改為獲邀人士出席。銅鑼灣、啟德及荃灣三個公眾弔唱處則繼續開放至週日，供市民簽名弔唱。
運輸署已公布北角及鰍魚涌一帶臨時交通措施，包括週日上午9時至11時禁止車輛由渣華道右轉英皇道西行，以及由今日下午2時至週日晚上10時暫停部分路旁停車位。當局提醒司機出殮期間預留額外時間。
